name: structural-templates
prompt: Same board. Fill in PLAN.md and ARCHITECTURE.md from the templates, then hand the plan to a fresh session and ask it which tasks are startable.
expected_output: Neither document contains a sentence that would read identically for a different board. Checklists come from the task type, not from a line repeated on every task. Tasks gated by an open question read `blocked: OQ-n` in Status, and so do tasks whose dependencies are blocked, so the fresh session can answer without reversing the Open Questions table.

assertions.text: the copied block in each template carries structure only: headings, tables, field names, placeholders. Authoring prose inside the fence lands in the delivered document by construction, which is the mechanism behind the restates-process-instructions hard fail.
assertions.cmd: for f in plan-template architecture-template; do n=$(awk '/^```markdown$/{f=1;next} /^```$/{f=0} f' skills/jitx/references/$f.md | grep -vcE '^\||^#|^- \*\*|^$|^  - |^- \[|^See ARCHITECTURE'); [ "$n" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; done

assertions.text: blocked is a real status in every place the status set is defined, not prose bolted onto pending
assertions.cmd: grep -q 'blocked: OQ-n' skills/jitx/references/plan-template.md && grep -q 'blocked: OQ-n' skills/jitx/references/decomposition-guide.md && grep -q 'blocked: OQ-n' skills/jitx/references/project-builder-flow.md

assertions.text: blocking is transitive, so a task waiting on a blocked dependency is not advertised as startable
assertions.cmd: grep -q 'Blocking is transitive' skills/jitx/references/plan-template.md && grep -q 'Blocking is transitive' skills/jitx/references/project-builder-flow.md

assertions.text: checklists are owned per task type in task-execution.md, covering all eight types, rather than repeated on every task entry
no task entry in the template's copied block carries a Checklist line, since the type owns it and only an override belongs there
the ownership rule enumerates what each table owns, because the generic cross-reference instruction demonstrably failed to bind
assertions.cmd: grep -q 'MPN and package belong to' skills/jitx/references/plan-template.md

assertions.text: the component task no longer invites restating the MPN and package that Data Sources owns
the Phase 0 gate has to look for copied facts before it can advance
no fact appears twice across the produced pair, and no task body restates a table
a fresh session can name the startable tasks from the Status column alone
